{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
A "'''Hutt's cry'''" was a slang term used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to describe the sound made when a batch of worm-like [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]] hatched from their [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. The term originated from an incident that occurred<ref name="K'lor'slug">{{TORcite|type=codex|K'lor'slug}}</ref> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3743 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=codex|K'lor'slug}} is a codex entry that can be found in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'', which takes place roughly ten to twelve years after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] according to ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]]. {{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5365704|text=Community}} Since the Treaty of Coruscant was signed in [[3653 BBY]] according to ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', this places the events of the game at approximately [[3643 BBY]] to [[3640 BBY]]. This article uses the date of 3643 BBY as an approximate date, which would place Hetuu's death around [[3743 BBY]], but the actual date could be different.</ref> when a hunter named [[Riegenn Hetuu]] was hired by a [[Unidentified Hutt (Riegenn Hetuu)|Hutt]] to capture a live k'lor'slug queen. Hetuu had not taken the creature's high [[Reproduction/Legends|reproductive]] rate into account, and a hoard of nearly four hundred k'lor'slugs hatched in his [[Unidentified starship (Riegenn Hetuu)|ship's]] cargo bay by the time he arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]. When he opened the cargo bay to show his client his prize, the released k'lor'slugs [[Death/Legends|devoured]] both Hetuu and his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] client. The term was still used<ref name="K'lor'slug" /> around the year [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

==Behind the scenes==
The term "Hutt's cry" was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. The term was mentioned in the k'lorslug codex entry, which could be found by players who killed the k'lor'slug broodwatcher in the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|tomb]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ajunta Pall]] on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="K'lor'slug" />
